$comment: The one machine-readable list of what exists where. Every script that needs to
know an environment's branch, site, update channel or project reads this file;
nothing else keeps its own copy. Two copies of this table is how staging ended
up with a site on one commit, an OTA channel on another, and two repositories
Keys are never stored here. The app's publishable keys live in
src/services/appEnvironments.ts (a build needs to import them); this file only
names which project each environment is, so a reader can tell whether the
site.role is the difference that used to be invisible:
delivered  — this URL is the environment. It must match the branch.
mirror     — a convenience copy for looking at the dev branch; it runs against
whatever .env.local held at build time, so it is not evidence.

site.note: A static copy of the dev branch for looking at. Its backend was whatever .env.local held when it was built, so it proves layout, never data.

ota.why: Pinned to this repository because dev APKs were built to poll it.

backend.note: Docker on the developer's machine. Nothing here reaches a shared project.

ota.why: The canonical repository. Its workflow token can publish releases here and cannot in abakhsh56.
Every installed production app polls this channel; moving it would strand them until a reinstall.
